data.narrative:
Varda Space Industries, a Series D-stage space infrastructure company founded by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov, is valued at $1.58B post-money following $329M in cumulative capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers in Space & Aerospace, including Apex Space, Sierra Space, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $1.5B last post-money valuation and applying a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement, implies $2.2B. Peer-median anchoring across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $2.3B, with the peer set spanning $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x P/S across six public names, Varda's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $1.9B to $2.6B, with a median of $2.3B. The current $1.58B valuation sits below this derived range, suggesting potential upside to next-round pricing. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory (critical to public-comp validation), competitive positioning within the in-space manufacturing subsector, and execution risk on orbital operations.
